items.reason: Temozolomide is optional in Phase 2 ('Avutometinib and defactinib may be administered in combination with temozolomide (TMZ)') and an outcome describes it as 'combination with TMZ when given as standard of care maintenance therapy'; it is the standard backbone, not a third investigational agent. The 'triplet' label does not make an established GBM drug investigational (rule 6 needs a new dose/schedule/route, not stated).

'unmethylated GBM' appears only in an outcome ('For front line unmethylated GBM (MRD):'); the eligibility definition of the front-line MRD cohort ('eligible following completion of optimal surgery and Stupp based adjuvant chemoradiotherapy') requires no MGMT value, so under D31-A3 it is not selection.

note: Primary outcome (candidate_matched_selection true via BRAF and NF1 cohort definitions matched to avutometinib) is agreed by both coders and will also be reviewed under D21(a); BRAF/NF1 are cohort definitions, so D31-A3 is met and any_molecular_selection stays true. MGMT row re-coded exploratory_correlative under D31-A3 (only in an outcome label); no proposed_final change. A6 resolved (D31-A6 corrected): the BRAF/NF1-avutometinib link comes from avutometinib's established RAF/MEK pharmacology (own knowledge), so candidate_matched true stands.

revisions.reason: MGMT 'unmethylated' appears only in the primary-outcome text, not in the eligibility criteria or the MRD cohort definition, so it is not an entry requirement.
